question: The draft of the 'Telecommunications (Administration of Digital Bharat Nidhi) Rules, 2024' was published for public consultation on which date?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4 July 2024**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The new rules aim to enhance the management and implementation of the Digital Bharat Nidhi initiative.
 
• The Universal Service Obligation Fund has been renamed as Digital Bharat Nidhi to address emerging technological demands.
